title: Generate DFT input files
action: Using the paper's description, create Quantum ESPRESSO input files for pure c‑BN, B0.9375V0.0625N, and B0.875V0.125N zincblende supercells with a series of volumes. Set GGA‑PBE, 40 Ry wavefunction cutoff, 400 Ry density cutoff, 6x6x4 k‑points, and spin‑polarized calculations for the doped compounds.

title: Run DFT SCF calculations
action: Execute pw.x for all structures and volumes, producing total energies and self‑consistent charge densities. For the doped compounds, perform spin‑polarized calculations to determine the most stable magnetic phase (FM vs AFM). Save total energies, magnetizations, and output files.

title: Extract structural properties
action: Fit the total energy vs volume data to the Murnaghan equation of state for each compound. Compute equilibrium lattice constant (Å), bulk modulus (GPa), and total energy (eV). Write results as a JSON array of objects with keys compound, lattice_constant_A, bulk_modulus_GPa, total_energy_eV.
description: Ground‑state structural properties (lattice constant, bulk modulus, total energy) of c‑BN and V‑doped compounds.
output_schema: array of objects: { compound: string, lattice_constant_A: number, bulk_modulus_GPa: number, total_energy_eV: number }

title: Compute minority‑spin band gaps
action: For the equilibrium structures of the two V‑doped compounds, calculate spin‑polarized band structures along high‑symmetry paths and determine the minority‑spin band gap (eV). Write a JSON object mapping compound (string) to minority_spin_band_gap_eV (float).
description: Minority‑spin band gaps of the V‑doped c‑BN compounds.

title: Extract total magnetic moments
action: From the spin‑polarized SCF output of the doped compounds, read the total magnetization (μB) per supercell. Write a JSON object mapping compound (string) to total_magnetic_moment_muB_per_cell (float).
description: Total magnetic moments per supercell for the V‑doped compounds.
